mapper.sql: MENU_NUMB , SUBX_NUMB , MENU_NAME , MENU_URLX , SORT_ORDR , USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , UPDT_DATE
P.MENU_NUMB , P.SUBX_NUMB , P.MENU_NAME , P.MENU_URLX , P.SORT_ORDR , P.USEE_YSNO , P.USEE_YSNO_NAME , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_ADMN , P.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , P.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT /* getMenuList */ M.MENU_NUMB , M.SUBX_NUMB , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_URLX , M.SORT_ORDR , M.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, M.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , M.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , M.REGI_DATE , M.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , M.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_ADMENU M JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB AND A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} AND A.READ_YSNO = #{yes} JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE AND COALESCE(G.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} LEFT JOIN TM_ADMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND P.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} WHERE COALESCE(M.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} ORDER BY COALESCE(P.SORT_ORDR, M.SORT_ORDR) , CAST(M.MENU_NUMB AS UNSIGNED) , CASE WHEN M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , COALESCE(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , CAST(M.SUBX_NUMB AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT /* getMenuPermission */ COALESCE(MAX(A.READ_YSNO), #{no}) AS READ_YSNO , COALESCE(MAX(A.WRIT_YSNO), #{no}) AS WRIT_YSNO , COALESCE(MAX(A.DELT_YSNO), #{no}) AS DELT_YSNO FROM TM_ADMENU M JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB AND A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE AND COALESCE(G.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} WHERE TRIM(M.MENU_URLX) = #{menuUrlx}
SELECT /* getMenuMngCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_ADMENU M WHERE M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb}
SELECT /* getMenuNumb */ CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(MENU_NUMB AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 AS CHAR) FROM TM_ADMENU WHERE SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb}
SELECT /* getSubxNumb */ CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBX_NUMB AS UNSIGNED)), -1) + 1 AS CHAR) FROM TM_ADMENU WHERE MENU_NUMB = #{menuNumb}
